title: Slimecrows
description: This datapack allows you to build functional "Slimecrows" to keep slimes out of your underground crops.
body:
Slimecrows
--------------------------------------
Ever gotten super annoyed by Slimes trampling all over your crops in your Cave Base? This datapack allows you to build functional "Slimecrows" to keep them out of your crops!

How to Build a Slimecrow
1.  Place a Fence Post (the leg).
2.  Place a Slime Block on top (the body).
3.  Place a Carved Pumpkin on top (the head).
4.  Activate it by throwing a Magma Cream on top of the pumpkin.

If successful, the Pumpkin will light up (turning into a Jack o' Lantern), emit ghostly soul fire, and nearby slimes will vanish instantly.

Notes
- Range: 32 Blocks (Spherical).
- If you break the Pumpkin or the Slime Block, the effect stops.
- Emits a subtle soul-fire wisp every few seconds to show it is still active.

Installation
1.  Download the `.zip`.
2.  Place in `.minecraft/saves/<world>/datapacks/`.
3.  Run `/reload`.

Uninstall: 
Run `/function slime_repeller:uninstall` before removing the datapack to clean things up
